Even if you find a workaround, it’s fragile—a single policy change could shut you down. This isn’t just frustrating; it’s a barrier to your livelihood. What you need isn’t another patch; you need infrastructure. Sovereign infrastructure. This post breaks down how to build a system that automates ebook delivery the moment a buyer sends [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-stack-started-generating-3|COREMERCH guide to crypto]]-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-infrastructure-reality-check-2|Crypto Payments]] payment—no middlemen, no subscriptions, no platform lock-in. By the end, you’ll understand the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-12|architecture]], the tools, and the steps to deploy it yourself. This isn’t a workaround. It’s ownership.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-plain-language-8. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

This is a complete commerce stack designed for digital creators who cannot rely on conventional payment processors. It’s built on open infrastructure: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC. The system automatically verifies payments on-chain and delivers your ebook instantly. You own the entire stack after deployment—no platform has access to your data or revenue stream. This isn’t a temporary fix; it’s a permanent solution built to withstand financial isolation and currency instability.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here’s how it operates: A buyer selects your ebook and pays in crypto. NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain and sends a webhook to your backend logic (Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script). The script checks the payment status, logs the order in Supabase or Google Sheets, and generates a secure, time-limited download link for the ebook hosted on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The buyer receives the link instantly via email or on a thank-you page. Every step is automated, and every component is replaceable. If NOWPayments changes its terms, swap it for another service. If Cloudflare raises prices, move to GitHub Pages. The architecture is modular, so you’re never locked in.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This system is for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and similar platforms are unavailable or unreliable. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, or software and need a way to collect payment and deliver products without depending on a third party, this is for you. It’s also for creators who value data ownership and infrastructure sovereignty. You’re not renting a platform; you’re building on infrastructure you control. This stack is pressure-tested in environments like Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and financial isolation are realities. It’s not just a technical solution—it’s a response to systemic exclusion from global payment networks.
This system is built for creators who value infrastructure sovereignty, not platform dependency.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack relies on five core components: 1. **Hosting**: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your storefront (free). 2. **Backend Logic**: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle payment verification and file delivery (free or low-cost). 3. **Order Storage**: Supabase or Google Sheets to log transactions (free tier available). 4. **File Storage**: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to host your ebook files (free or low-cost). 5. **Payment Processing**: NOWPayments for crypto payments with a 0.5% fee and no KYC. These components integrate seamlessly, and the system is designed to scale. Start with a single ebook, then expand to courses, templates, or software. The Complete Builder Kit includes blueprints and templates for all five stacks, so you can deploy in hours, not weeks.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by mapping your requirements: which cryptocurrencies will you accept? Where will you host your files? Once you’ve decided, follow these steps: 1. Set up a NOWPayments account and configure webhooks. 2. Deploy your storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 3. Write the backend logic in Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle payment verification and file delivery. 4. Connect your order storage (Supabase or Google Sheets) and file storage (Google Drive or Cloudflare R2). 5. Test end-to-end: simulate a purchase, verify the payment, and ensure the ebook is delivered. If you’re not a developer, the Complete Builder Kit provides pre-built templates and step-by-step guides. Deploy in 48 hours and own your infrastructure permanently.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

This system automates ebook delivery after a buyer sends crypto payment. It uses NOWPayments to verify transactions, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle backend logic, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to deliver the file. The buyer receives a secure download link instantly. You own the entire stack, and there are no recurring fees or platform dependencies. It’s built for creators who cannot use Stripe or PayPal and need a sovereign commerce solution.
Deploy in 48 hours with the Complete Builder Kit—no coding required.

If you’re ready to deploy this system today, the Complete Builder Kit includes all the blueprints, templates, and guides you need. It’s $197 and available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This isn’t a course or a tutorial—it’s a kit for building infrastructure you own. No subscriptions, no platform lock-in, just sovereignty.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting platform: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 2. Set up a NOWPayments account and configure webhooks for payment verification. 3. Write or deploy backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 4. Connect your order storage: Supabase or Google Sheets. 5. Upload your ebook to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 6. Test the entire flow: simulate a purchase, verify payment, and confirm file delivery. 7. Deploy your storefront and start selling. 8. Monitor transactions and scale as needed.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this system if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes pre-built templates and step-by-step guides. You don’t need to write code from scratch, but basic technical familiarity is helpful.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON, with transactions under $0.10.
Do I need to pay recurring fees?
No. After deployment, you own the infrastructure. The only fee is NOWPayments’ 0.5% transaction charge.
What happens if NOWPayments changes its terms?
The system is modular. You can replace NOWPayments with another crypto payment processor without disrupting your storefront or backend logic.
Can I sell products other than ebooks?
Yes. The same architecture works for courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. Adjust the file delivery logic as needed.
